title: PREBA: Surgical Duration Prediction via PCA-Weighted Retrieval-Augmented LLMs and Bayesian Averaging Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2603.13275v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate prediction of surgical duration is pivotal for hospital resource management. Although recent supervised learning approaches, from machine learning (ML) to fine-tuned large language models (LLMs), have shown strong performance, they remain constrained by the need for high-quality labeled data and computationally intensive training. In contrast, zero-shot LLM inference offers a promising training-free alternative, but it lacks grounding in institution-specific clinical evidence, making its predictions clinically misaligned and prone to instability. translated_abstract: 手术时长的准确预测对医院资源管理至关重要。尽管近年来从机器学习（ML）到微调大语言模型（LLM）等监督学习方法已展现出强大的性能，但它们仍受限于对高质量标注数据和计算密集型训练的依赖。相比之下，零样本LLM推理提供了一种无需训练的有前景的替代方案，但其缺乏对特定机构临床证据的支撑，导致预测结果与临床实际脱节且容易不稳定。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了PREBA，这是一个检索增强框架，它集成了PCA加权检索和贝叶斯平均聚合，将LLM的推理建立在特定机构的临床证据之上，而无需任务特定的微调。具体而言，PREBA首先将异构的临床特征编码为统一的表示形式，然后执行PCA加权检索……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PREBA提出了一种融合PCA加权检索与贝叶斯平均聚合的检索增强框架，无需任务特定微调即可将大语言模型的推理锚定于机构特定的临床证据上，从而实现准确且稳定的手术时长预测。
en_tdlr: PREBA is a retrieval-augmented framework that combines PCA-weighted retrieval and Bayesian averaging aggregation to ground LLM reasoning in institution-specific clinical evidence without task-specific fine-tuning, enabling accurate and stable surgical duration prediction.
